name: deckcraft-bridge
description: Create, edit and convert presentations with the DeckCraft app installed on Windows, macOS or Linux: slides with bullets, pictures, charts, tables and notes, themes, transitions, PowerPoint pptx, pdf and slide images. Not affiliated with DeckCraft or Storytold.

deckcraft_dir.title: DeckCraft folder
deckcraft_dir.description: Install folder of DeckCraft (or DeckCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\DeckCraft, /Applications/DeckCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/deckcraft or PATH.

deckcraft_cli.title: deckcraft-cli executable (optional)
deckcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped the deckcraft-cli zip on macOS.

control_port.title: DeckCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the DeckCraft app (open_in_deckcraft, run_deckcraft_commands live). Default 7990.
